interpretation.name: TightenLine3FastenersWithSharedNutrunner
interpretation.goal: Bring the shared nutrunner NR7 from the crib to station st3, tighten the fasteners of variant F35 with the program obtained from get-program, evaluate and record the result, then return NR7 to the crib and release it.
constraints: NR7 must be reserved for line 3 before any use, and the reservation must be released only after NR7 is back in the crib (E1, E6).
Every tool-using Step depends on the reserve-tool Step and renews the lease with its reservation token (E6).
transport-tool Steps must be executed by agvexecutor (E2).
NR7 must be at station st3 before configure-tool or tighten-fasteners is invoked (E3).
The tightening program for F35 comes only from get-program; no torque, tolerance, bolt count or program values appear in the Recipe (E4).
Every tightening is evaluated against its program and recorded for traceability (E5).
NR7 is returned to the crib when the work is done (operator request).
interpretation.horizon: One-time execution for the current request on line 3 (variant F35), until NR7 is back in the crib and released.
